profile.headline: Software Engineer 2 @ Booz Allen Hamilton
profile.summary: Software Engineer 2 in Booz Allen Hamilton

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and optimized back-end features using C# and SQL Server across multiple Azure DevOps user stories, improving
application performance, scalability, and reliability for sprint deliverables.
• Built and enhanced responsive front-end interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Razor Pages, jQuery, and Bootstrap,
improving usability, accessibility, and overall user experience.
• Translated business requirements and Azure DevOps user stories into technical solutions, delivering multiple features per
sprint and improving customer workflows.
• Developed and optimized high-performance Oracle SQL reports, reducing report generation time by 50% and improving data
accessibility for stakeholders.
• Tested applications, validated new features, debugged production issues, resolved ServiceNow tickets, and implemented fixes to support stable sprint releases.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · HTML · JavaScript · CSS · Git · Azure DevOps · Agile Methodologies · Oracle SQL Developer · Slack · ServiceNow

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst I
positions.description:
• Developed a full-stack C# ASP.NET MVC application for copy product ordering with MSSQL and Bootstrap, enabling catalog management, order workflows, and admin reporting for 100+ employees.
• Designed a C# ASP.NET MVC software license tracking system with MSSQL and Bootstrap, improving visibility, reducing manual tracking, and streamlining inventory for 1,000+ employees.
• Built an OnBase solution with a custom C# app to extract HR data from MSSQL into structured folders, automating PDF ingestion via OnBase DIP for 2,000+ records.
• Implemented a C# integration to sync data between Remedy and FAMIS work orders, improving accessibility and cutting ticket lookup time by 30%.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET MVC · Entity Framework · Microsoft SQL Server · Git · HTML · CSS · BMC Remedy AR System

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed interactive analytics dashboards using C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, and SQL to monitor API performance, provide
real-time insights, and accelerate error diagnostics for internal stakeholders.
• Designed, built, and optimized Mule flows using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform Mule 4 to improve integration reliability, data
transformation, and processing efficiency.
• Enhanced a project tracking system using C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, and SQL, improving task management, deadline
tracking, reporting, and team visibility.
• Supported Salesforce end-users by managing Jira tickets, restoring access, provisioning accounts, and resolving application
issues while helping reduce resolution time and user downtime.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a RESTful API using Java, Spring, and PostgreSQL on AWS RDS that delivers Riot Games data
• Led a team of 15+ and a focused subteam of 3 to design and implement a dashboard aggregating grocery data from multiple sources (databases, CSV files, APIs)
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · PostgreSQL · Git · Mule
